title: Codex account brief: word queue resumption by queue head, and scope prompt refusal to local sessions
outcome: The Codex account brief describes exactly which queued prompts resume on their own after an account action and that the refusal of typed prompts applies to local Codex sessions.
acceptance: docs/features/codex-account-login.md says that a queue whose next prompt is a mailbox or workflow prompt resumes on its own after an account action leaves a usable account, and that any other queue (including one paused independently, for example by Stop) runs with a later prompt or wake when the queue allows dispatch.
The same paragraph says that the refusal of prompts typed in TermAl applies to local Codex sessions, and its line wrapping is tidied.
